# THE CLAUDE PROMPT VAULT — COMPANION DOC

108 Copy-Paste Prompts · Click to Copy · GlowHaus Digital

*This is your bonus companion doc. Every prompt below is plain text, formatted to copy cleanly — no PDF line-break weirdness. Find your prompt, select the text, copy, paste into Claude, swap the [BRACKETS], go.*

## SECTION 1: DAILY LIFE & EVERYDAY TASKS

**001 — Explain It Simply**

Explain [topic] to me like I am a complete beginner. Use simple words, one relatable analogy, and one real-world example I can picture right away.

**002 — Prioritize My Day**

I have [X hours] today and need to do: [list tasks]. Prioritize by urgency and importance and give me a realistic time-block schedule I can actually follow.

**003 — Help Me Decide**

I am choosing between [Option A] and [Option B]. My priorities are [what matters to you]. Walk me through the pros and cons clearly so I can decide with confidence.

**004 — Quick Email Reply**

Draft a professional and friendly reply to this email: [paste email]. My response should [agree/decline/ask a question]. Keep it under 5 sentences.

**005 — Summarize This**

Read the following and give me a clear bullet-point summary of the 5 most important things I need to know: [paste your text here].

**006 — Learn Something Fast**

I want to understand [topic] in 15 minutes. Give me the core concepts, one memorable analogy, and 3 questions I should be able to answer when done.

**007 — Turn Overwhelm Into a Plan**

I feel overwhelmed by everything on my plate today: [list everything, even small things]. Sort it into must-do, should-do, and can-wait, then tell me exactly what to tackle first and why.

**008 — Compare Two Options Honestly**

I'm deciding between [Option A] and [Option B] for [situation]. My budget/timeline/priority is [detail]. Give me your honest recommendation, not just a balanced list — tell me what you'd actually choose and why.

**009 — Build a Realistic Weekly Plan**

Help me plan a realistic week around these fixed commitments: [list them]. I also want progress on [goal]. Build a schedule that accounts for real energy levels, not an idealized version of my week.

## SECTION 2: WRITING & PERSONAL MESSAGES

**010 — Heartfelt Apology**

Write a sincere apology to [person/relationship]. The situation: [brief description]. I want them to feel heard without me making excuses or being defensive.

**011 — Thank You Note**

Write a warm, personal thank-you note to [person] for [what they did]. Make it feel genuine and specific to them — not a generic copy-paste message.

**012 — Birthday Message**

Write a creative birthday message for [name]. Their personality: [describe in a few words]. Make it feel written just for them, not like a greeting card.

**013 — Instagram Bio**

Write 3 versions of an Instagram bio for me. I am a [what you do]. Vibe: [fun/professional/edgy]. Maximum 150 characters each. Make each one distinct.

**014 — Complaint Letter**

Write a firm but professional complaint letter to [company] about [issue]. I want to explain what happened and request [resolution] without sounding angry.

**015 — Cover Letter Opener**

I am applying for [job title] at [company]. My background: [brief summary]. Write an engaging opening paragraph that grabs attention immediately.

**016 — Difficult Conversation Starter**

Help me start a hard conversation with [person] about [issue]. I want to be honest without being harsh, and I want them to stay open instead of getting defensive. Give me a calm opening line.

**017 — Condolence Message**

Write a heartfelt condolence message for [person] who lost [relationship]. I knew [the deceased] as [brief detail]. Keep it warm, specific, and free of clichés like “they're in a better place.”

**018 — Reference or Recommendation Request**

Write a message asking [person] to be a reference or write a recommendation for [purpose]. Remind them briefly of our history: [context]. Make it easy and low-pressure for them to say yes.

## SECTION 3: CONTENT CREATION

**019 — YouTube Hook**

Write a 30-second spoken hook for a YouTube video about [topic]. Address a pain point immediately, create curiosity, and make the viewer feel they NEED to keep watching.

**020 — Blog Post Outline**

Create a detailed blog post outline for [title] targeting [audience]. Include: a strong intro hook, catchy H2 subheadings with bullet points, and a CTA conclusion.

**021 — Repurpose Content**

I have this content: [paste it]. Repurpose into: 1) A Twitter/X thread 2) An Instagram caption 3) A 60-second TikTok script 4) An email newsletter intro.

**022 — Video Title Ideas**

Give me 10 YouTube video title ideas for a video about [topic]. Mix: curiosity gaps, numbered lists, how-to formats, and emotional hooks. Target: [your audience].

**023 — Viral Caption**

Write 5 Instagram captions for [photo or topic]. Each needs: an attention-grabbing first line, a relatable story, a question to drive comments, and 3 hashtag ideas.

**024 — Email Newsletter**

Write a weekly email for [audience]. Topic: [topic]. Include: a catchy subject line, a personal opening, 3 value-packed tips, and a soft CTA pointing to [action].

**025 — Script Hook Bank**

Give me 8 opening lines for a video about [topic]. Mix formats: a bold claim, a confession, a question, and a “wait for it” tease. I want the first 3 seconds to stop the scroll.

**026 — Turn a Comment Into Content**

A follower commented: [paste comment]. Turn this into a full piece of content — script, caption, or post — that answers their question in a way that helps my wider audience too.

**027 — Content Pillar Builder**

Help me define 4 content pillars for my [niche/brand]. For each pillar, give me the purpose, 5 example topics, and how often I should post it relative to the others.

## SECTION 4: SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY

**028 — 30-Day Content Calendar**

Build a 30-day content calendar for [platform] for a [type of brand]. Include: post themes, content formats, and suggested posting frequency. My niche: [niche].

**029 — Story Sequence**

Write a 5-slide Instagram Story sequence to promote [product or offer]. Each slide should build curiosity leading to a strong CTA on the final slide. Include suggested text per slide.

**030 — TikTok Hook Bank**

Generate 15 TikTok opening lines for [topic]. Stop the scroll in 2 seconds. Use: shocking stat, bold claim, relatable confession, POV, and “tell me why” formats.

**031 — Comment Response Bank**

Write 10 response templates for replying to comments on my [product or content] posts. Mix tones: grateful, funny, engaging, professional. Each should feel natural, not robotic.

**032 — Hashtag Strategy**

I post about [niche] on Instagram. Build a hashtag strategy: 5 large tags over 1M, 10 medium tags 100K–500K, and 10 niche tags under 50K that match [specific topic].

**033 — Competitor Research**

Act as a social media strategist. What makes successful [niche] creators on [platform] stand out? What content formats perform best and what gaps could I fill?

**034 — Reels/TikTok Batch Plan**

I have [X hours] to film content for [platform]. Give me 5 video concepts I can batch-film in one sitting for [niche], including the hook, main point, and CTA for each.

**035 — Bio Optimization Audit**

Here's my current bio: [paste bio]. My audience is [describe]. My goal is [follow/click/buy]. Rewrite it to be clearer and more compelling, and tell me what was weak about the original.

**036 — Engagement Recovery Plan**

My engagement on [platform] has dropped over [timeframe]. My recent content has been about [topics]. Diagnose 3 likely reasons and give me a 2-week plan to recover momentum.

## SECTION 5: BUSINESS & EMAIL

**037 — Cold Outreach Email**

Write a cold outreach email to [type of business or person]. My role: [your role]. Goal: [get a meeting or collab]. Keep it under 150 words. Sound human, not like a sales robot.

**038 — Follow-Up Email**

Write a follow-up email for a [meeting/proposal/interview] from [X days] ago. Reference [something specific discussed]. Be warm and professional with a clear next step.

**039 — Proposal Template**

Create a professional project proposal for [type of project]. Include: overview, scope of work, deliverables, timeline, investment section, and a next steps section I can customize.

**040 — Negotiate Your Rate**

Write a message to [client] negotiating my rate from [$X] to [$Y]. My value points: [list them]. Tone: confident and collaborative — not an ultimatum, not desperate.

**041 — Client Onboarding Email**

Write a professional welcome email for a new client who just signed with my [service type] business. Include: warm welcome, what to expect, next steps, contact info, and timeline.

**042 — Meeting Agenda**

Create a focused meeting agenda for a [type of meeting] with [who]. Duration: [X minutes]. Outcome: [goal]. Include time per topic and a clear action items section at the end.

**043 — Boundary-Setting Email**

Write an email to [person] setting a clear boundary about [issue]. Firm but professional — I want to preserve the relationship, not end it.

**044 — Vendor or Supplier Inquiry**

Write an inquiry email to [supplier/vendor] about [product/service]. Ask about [pricing, MOQ, lead time]. Sound like an established small business, confident and specific.

**045 — Apology for a Business Mistake**

Write an email to [client/customer] apologizing for [what went wrong]. I want to take responsibility, explain the fix, and offer [remedy] — without groveling or making excuses.

## SECTION 6: SALES & COPYWRITING

**046 — Product Description**

Write a compelling product description for [product name]. Features: [list]. Target buyer: [describe]. Lead with the transformation and benefit, not just the specs. Close with a CTA.

**047 — Sales Page Headlines**

Write 10 headline options for a sales page selling [product or service]. Mix: transformation, curiosity, specificity, social proof, and pain-point opener. Target audience: [describe].

**048 — Launch Announcement**

Write a product launch announcement for [product] going live on [date]. Include: what it is, who it is for, what makes it different, what is included, price, and a strong CTA.

**049 — FAQ That Sells**

Create an FAQ section for [product or service] that proactively answers the top 8 buyer objections. Make each answer persuasive and confidence-building, not just informative.

**050 — Testimonial Request**

Write a short casual message to send to past customers asking for a testimonial. Suggest 3 specific questions to make it easy for them. Do not make it feel like homework.

**051 — Abandoned Cart Emails**

Write a 3-email abandoned cart sequence for [product]. Email 1: gentle reminder. Email 2: address objections with social proof. Email 3: last chance with urgency.

**052 — Objection-Crushing Script**

My potential customers keep hesitating because [objection]. Write 3 short responses I can use in DMs or comments that address this without sounding pushy.

**053 — Bundle or Upsell Pitch**

I sell [product]. Help me design a bundle or upsell offer that pairs it with [related item/service]. Write the pitch copy, framed as a no-brainer add-on, not a hard sell.

**054 — Scarcity Without Sleaze**

Write urgency copy for [offer] that ends on [date/quantity]. I want real scarcity, not fake countdown-timer energy — make it feel like an honest heads-up, not manipulation.

## SECTION 7: STRATEGY & PLANNING

**055 — 90-Day Business Sprint**

Help me build a 90-day action plan to [specific goal]. Starting from: [current situation]. Break into 3 monthly sprints with weekly actions, success metrics, and how to handle obstacles.

**056 — Revenue Stream Ideas**

I run a [business type] for [audience]. Brainstorm 10 revenue streams I could add — from passive to active, easy to complex. Rate each by profit potential and difficulty to launch.

**057 — Build a System (SOP)**

Build a step-by-step standard operating procedure for [task]. Make it clear enough that I could delegate it to someone else immediately without explaining anything verbally.

**058 — Full Launch Strategy**

Create a pre-launch, launch, and post-launch strategy for [product] launching in [timeframe]. Include: audience warming, content plan, email sequence outline, and launch week schedule.

**059 — Pricing Strategy**

Help me price [product or service]. My costs: [X]. Competitors charge: [range]. My audience: [describe]. Give me 3 pricing tiers — budget, mid, premium — with psychological framing for each.

**060 — SWOT Analysis**

Run a detailed SWOT analysis on [my business or idea]. Be specific, not generic. After the analysis, give me 3 strategic moves that turn my weaknesses and threats into opportunities.

**061 — Decision Framework**

I'm trying to decide whether to [decision]. Here's what's true: [relevant facts/constraints]. Build me a simple decision framework — the 3 questions I should answer to make this call with confidence.

**062 — Burnout-Proof Workload Audit**

Here's everything currently on my plate: [list all projects/brands/tasks]. Help me identify what's actually moving the needle versus what's just busywork, and recommend what to pause, delegate, or drop.

**063 — Quarterly Goal Reverse-Engineer**

My goal for this quarter is [goal]. Reverse-engineer it into monthly targets, then weekly actions for month one. Be specific — no vague “post consistently” advice.

## SECTION 8: RESEARCH & ANALYSIS

**064 — Market Research Brief**

Act as a market research analyst. Give me a detailed overview of the [niche or industry] market. Include: size, key trends, top players, consumer behavior shifts, and opportunities for a new entrant.

**065 — Competitor Deep Dive**

Analyze [competitor name or type] in the [industry] space. What do they do well? Where are their gaps? What are customers complaining about? How can I position to attract frustrated buyers?

**066 — Buyer Persona**

Build a detailed buyer persona for my ideal customer interested in [product or topic]. Include: demographics, psychographics, daily pain points, goals, buying objections, and exact words they use.

**067 — Data Interpretation**

Here is data from my [analytics or survey]: [paste it]. Interpret what this means, identify the 3 most important takeaways, and suggest specific actions I should take based on these numbers.

**068 — Trend Spotting**

Analyze current trends in [industry or niche]. What is growing? What is declining? What is emerging that most people have not noticed? Give me actionable insights to position my brand.

**069 — Research Summary**

Summarize the following in plain language: [paste article or research]. Tell me: what was studied, what they found, what it means practically, and what I should do with this information.

**070 — Read the Room (Audience Sentiment)**

Here are comments, reviews, or messages from my audience: [paste examples]. Identify the recurring themes, the emotional tone, and 3 things they're telling me they want that I'm not currently giving them.

**071 — Pricing Benchmark Check**

I sell [product/service] at [price]. Research how similar products or services are typically priced in [niche/market]. Tell me if I'm underpriced, overpriced, or in the right range, and why.

**072 — Risk Check Before You Launch**

I'm about to launch or invest in [idea]. Play devil's advocate: what are the 3 biggest risks or reasons this could fail, and what would you do differently before moving forward?

## SECTION 9: DIGITAL MARKETING

**073 — Ad Copy Variations**

Write 5 Facebook and Instagram ad variations for [product or offer]. Each needs a different angle: problem-led, aspiration-led, social proof, curiosity, and urgency. Include headline, body, and CTA for each.

**074 — SEO Content Strategy**

Build an SEO content strategy for [type of site] targeting [niche]. Give me: 10 high-intent keyword clusters, 5 pillar page ideas, 20 supporting blog post topics, and internal linking suggestions.

**075 — Email Welcome Sequence**

Design a 7-email welcome sequence for new subscribers to my [list type] newsletter. Goal: build trust, deliver value, introduce my offer, and convert. Map out subject line and goal for each email.

**076 — Lead Magnet Ideas**

Generate 10 lead magnet ideas for [business type] targeting [audience]. For each: a title, format, core value proposition. Rank by perceived value and ease of creation.

**077 — Influencer Pitch DM**

Write a short DM to a [micro or mid-tier] influencer in [niche] for a [collab or gifting or paid] partnership. My brand: [describe]. Make it genuine and exciting — not copy-paste template spam.

**078 — Retargeting Strategy**

Build a retargeting ad strategy for people who visited [my site or sales page] but did not convert. What audiences should I build? What messaging for each stage? What offers should I lead with?

**079 — Organic Growth Audit**

My [platform/site] traffic has been flat despite posting [frequency] about [niche]. Audit what might be holding growth back and give me 3 specific changes to try this month.

**080 — Email List Re-Engagement**

My email list hasn't heard from me in [timeframe]. Write a re-engagement email that acknowledges the gap honestly, delivers value immediately, and invites them back without sounding apologetic or desperate.

**081 — Cross-Platform Repost Strategy**

I created this content for [platform]: [paste or describe it]. Show me how to adapt it for [2-3 other platforms] without it feeling like a lazy repost — different hook, same core idea.

## SECTION 10: SKINCARE & BEAUTY BUSINESS

**082 — Product Launch Email**

Write a product launch email for a new [skincare product] called [name]. Benefits: [list]. Target: [skin type or concern]. Open with intrigue, highlight the hero ingredient, promise a transformation, close with CTA.

**083 — Ingredient Explainer**

Explain what [ingredient name] does for skin in simple, exciting language a non-expert would love to share. Cover: what it does, who needs it, expected results timeline, and how to layer it correctly.

**084 — Skincare Routine Builder**

Create a complete AM and PM skincare routine for [skin type or concern]. Include: product categories, order of application, why each step matters, and what ingredients to avoid layering together.

**085 — UGC Pitch to Beauty Brand**

Write an outreach email to [brand name] as a UGC creator specializing in skincare and beauty. I create [content type]. Make it feel personal — like I genuinely love the brand. Not a generic pitch template.

**086 — Beauty Content Hook Bank**

Write 15 content hooks for skincare and beauty creators on [platform]. Mix: shocking skin facts, transformation teasers, myth-busting, watch-me POVs, and relatable confessions. Make each one stop the scroll.

**087 — Review Response Templates**

Write professional, warm responses to these customer reviews: [paste a 1-star and 5-star review]. The 1-star should be empathetic and solution-focused. The 5-star should feel personal and grateful.

**088 — Debunk a Skincare Myth**

Write a myth-busting script about [common skincare myth]. Explain what people believe, why it's wrong, and what's actually true — in a fun, confident tone, not preachy or clinical.

**089 — Before/After Content Caption**

Write a caption for a before/after post about [product/result]. Lead with the transformation, mention the timeline honestly, and avoid overpromising — end with a soft CTA to learn more.

**090 — Skin-Type Personalization Quiz Copy**

Write 5 quiz questions to help someone identify their skin type or concern for [product line]. Each question should feel fun, not clinical, and lead naturally toward a product recommendation.

## SECTION 11: UGC & BRAND OUTREACH

**091 — Cold Pitch Email**

Write a cold pitch email to [brand name] as a UGC creator. I specialize in [niche or content type]. Make it personal, show I know the brand, explain the value I bring, and close with an easy next step.

**092 — Rate Negotiation Reply**

I have been offered [$X] for [deliverables] by [brand type]. Help me respond to negotiate a higher rate or better terms. Keep the relationship warm. Confident but collaborative — not demanding.

**093 — Follow-Up After Silence**

Write a follow-up message to a brand I pitched [X days] ago with no response. Reference something specific about their brand. Keep it short and confident — not desperate or apologetic.

**094 — Collab Proposal Email**

Write a collaboration proposal email to [brand] for a [gifted or paid or affiliate] partnership. I am a [niche] creator. Explain what I would create, who my audience is, and what specific value I bring.

**095 — Ask for a Contract**

Write a professional message asking a brand for a written agreement before I start work. Protect myself without seeming difficult. Friendly and businesslike — not aggressive or paranoid.

**096 — Request a Referral**

Write a message to a brand I successfully worked with asking if they would refer me to other brands or provide a testimonial for my media kit. Warm, confident, and brief — make it easy to say yes.

**097 — Media Kit One-Pager Copy**

Write the copy for a one-page media kit. My niche is [niche], platforms are [list], audience is [describe], and past results include [stats/brands if any]. Make it feel established, not amateur.

**098 — Turning Down a Bad-Fit Brand**

Write a polite decline to [brand] for [offer]. I want to leave the door open for future collabs that are a better fit, without over-explaining why this one isn't right.

**099 — Usage Rights Clarification**

Write a message asking [brand] to clarify usage rights and duration for the content I'm creating. I want to protect myself professionally without sounding distrustful or difficult.

## SECTION 12: META-PROMPTS

**100 — Improve My Prompt**

Here is a prompt I wrote: [paste your prompt]. Make it more specific, effective, and likely to get a high-quality response. Tell me what you changed and why.

**101 — Build a Template**

Create a reusable prompt template for [type of task]. Include [brackets] wherever someone would customize it. Clear enough for a beginner to use immediately.

**102 — Diagnose Bad Output**

I gave Claude this prompt: [paste it]. The output was disappointing because [describe problem]. Diagnose why the prompt failed and rewrite it to get better results.

**103 — Expand a Vague Idea**

I want to ask Claude to help me with [vague goal]. Turn this into a specific, detailed prompt that gives Claude everything it needs to give expert-level advice.

**104 — Build a Prompt Chain**

I want to accomplish [complex goal]. Break this into a sequence of 5 separate Claude prompts to run in order, where each builds on the last, for the best final result.

**105 — Test Multiple Angles**

Write 4 different prompts to explore [topic] from four angles: strategic, creative, analytical, and emotional. I want to compare the different responses each one generates.

**106 — Turn a Bad Answer Into a Good One**

Your last answer didn't quite work because [what was wrong — too generic, wrong tone, missed the point]. Keep what was useful, fix that specific issue, and give me a revised version.

**107 — Prompt Stack for a Recurring Task**

I do [recurring task] every [frequency]. Build me a reusable prompt template I can fill in each time, plus a short checklist of what good output should include.

**108 — Reverse-Engineer a Prompt From Great Output**

Here's an example of AI output I loved: [paste example]. Reverse-engineer what prompt likely produced this, then write me a similar prompt I can adapt for [my topic/use case].
